title: status.json: where a job is now
description: Rewritten whole (write to a temporary file, then replace) at every change and at least every 10 s while running. A reader that meets a half-written or locked file reads again a moment later.

state.description: done, failed and cancelled are final: result.json exists. A job resuming after a crash or a restart is queued (resuming: true) or running again. Right after submit a job is queued or running (a free worker may have started it already); a caller reads either. A job whose folder held a cancel file when letitedit claimed it is cancelled at once and never runs.

stage.description: The current step, from the kind's stages (CONTRACT.md). Open list.

counts.description: 1.2: while a stage works through a job's files (index: files, transcripts, moments), how many it has done of how many, with the minutes of footage (the files stage, which finds the lengths, gives no minutes). `progress` moves within the stage too. Kept after the stage, until the next stage reports its own.

message.description: One plain line for a person.

heartbeat.description: While running: renewed at least every 10 s. Older than 60 s with state running: letitedit's process stopped; the job will resume or fail cleanly.

resuming.description: Queued or running again after its process stopped (crash, restart); it continues from its last finished stage.

queue.description: Its place among Studio jobs: one Studio job runs at a time.

position.description: 0: running; 1: next; n: n-1 Studio jobs ahead of it.

what.description: Open list (CONTRACT.md section 2): a reader treats a value it doesn't know as "other". Known values: pc_lock, memory, person_working, ai_limit, studio_queue, previous_job.

ahead.description: pc_lock: how many waiters are ahead of this job in the PC lock's line.

holder.description: pc_lock: who holds it, in plain words.

until.description: ai_limit: when the usage limit resets, when known.

events.description: The seq of the last line written to events.jsonl.

outputs_so_far.description: Files already finished. Provisional until result.json says done.
